title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, default state and configuration instructions are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting Android documentation and remove the checklist's Facilitator app control step, which has no controls-table row.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Availability is automatic once licensing and prerequisites are met, without additional admin enablement.
claims.quote: The feature is available automatically once licensing and prerequisite configurations are met. No additional admin enablement is required beyond existing settings.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Show Take notes button on the home screen is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed into AI notes, summaries, decisions and action items.
claims.quote: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate AI-powered meeting notes, including summaries, decisions, and action items.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says in-person AI notes are saved as a Loop file in tenant SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant and users who saved the notes can access it later.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Learn treats the stored data as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The Facilitator setup page says AI-generated meeting notes are not automatically collected as eDiscovery cloud attachments.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The Facilitator setup page says retention labels are not supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes.
claims.quote: Retention labels aren't supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions: eDiscovery scope
claims.claim: Learn does not resolve whether its eDiscovery cloud-attachment limitation covers the in-person notes case.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms retention labels eDiscovery limitations. Read facilitator-teams, rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; none resolves automatic cloud-attachment collection for the room's SharePoint Embedded notes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Speaker identification and attribution currently require names added at the beginning and enrolled profiles.
claims.quote: Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Muting the room microphone prevents Facilitator or transcription from capturing content.
claims.quote: You can mute the microphone in the room to ensure Facilitator or transcription doesn't capture any content.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Facilitator enables transcription without recording the meeting.
claims.quote: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting. The meeting won't be recorded.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: In-person note-taking is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Each Teams Rooms resource account needs a Teams Rooms Pro licence for this capability.
claims.quote: Pre-requisite: Assign a Teams Rooms Pro license to each resource account you have for your Teams Rooms devices

claims.where: Cost and licensing: scheduled meetings comparison
claims.claim: The Teams Rooms page says only the meeting organiser needs a Copilot licence for scheduled meetings.
claims.quote: Only the meeting organizer requires a Copilot license.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn warns that the preview experience and licensing model may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: meter
claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms Learn page names no meter or separate charge for in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms Pro in-person notes meter price charge. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms in full, including licensing and prerequisites: included with Pro; no meter, unit rate or separate charge is named.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: price
claims.claim: Neither the feature page nor the Teams Rooms licenses Learn page publishes a Teams Rooms Pro price.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms Pro in-person notes meter price charge. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and rooms/rooms-licensing in full. Neither states a Pro price; the no-additional-cost statement concerns Basic.

claims.where: Scope: Windows and Android FAQ
claims.claim: Learn's FAQ says Windows is available and Android is projected for a future release.
claims.quote: Facilitator is available on Teams Rooms on Windows and is projected to release on Teams Rooms on Android in a future release.
claims.fix: After the FAQ sentence, add: 'However, the Android release notes list a preview of Facilitator note-taking for offline/ad-hoc discussions under 1449/1.0.96.2025126202 (May 2025).' The conflicting entry is at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Facilitator app must be enabled for the room resource account.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: People and Groups app scoping must include the resource account; Everyone already includes it.
claims.quote: If app availability is set to Everyone, the room account is included. If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls: availability
claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to ensure meeting transcription is enabled in meeting policies.
claims.quote: Ensure meeting transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to verify both IsLoopEnabled and IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls: availability
claims.claim: The room-level note-taking portal setting is part of the documented setup.
claims.quote: Step 4: Turn on note-taking for Teams Rooms

claims.claim: Changing device settings in the Pro Management portal requires Rooms Management RBAC permissions.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: rendered first row
claims.claim: Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen reaches the control.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: no API
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Take notes room setting as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Take notes setting API PowerShell Graph XML; Teams Rooms Take notes Graph API setting. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms, rooms/pro-portal-settings and new-teams-rooms-feature-not-available; no operation sets this control.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: rendered transcription row
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription reaches the meeting transcription setting.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: rendered transcription row
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the Global meeting policy.
claims.quote:
To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls: transcription scope; Open questions
claims.claim: The in-person setup does not specify which account's meeting policy governs its transcription requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in-person transcription policy room resource account organizer. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and meeting-transcription-captions; setup links to the general policy without identifying the governing account for in-person notes.

claims.where: Governance controls: transcription policy explanation
claims.claim: General meeting transcription is a per-organiser and per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls: Loop UI absence
claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path is documented for IsLoopEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI settings. Read loop-components-configuration in full; Teams uses SharePoint PowerShell, while its admin-centre checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not IsLoopEnabled.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls: rendered Loop row
claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams through SharePoint PowerShell.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.where: controls[2].scope and note
claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled controls Teams Loop creation and integration tenant-wide, not per user.
claims.quote: This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls: Loop UI absence
claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path is documented for IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI settings. Read loop-components-configuration and facilitator-teams; collaborative meeting notes use SharePoint PowerShell; neither documents a UI for this property.

claims.where: controls[3].api; Governance controls: rendered collaborative notes row
claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes through SharePoint PowerShell.
claims.quote: [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.where: controls[3].scope and note; Governance controls: Loop scope
claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled controls collaborative meeting notes tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.where: controls[3].note
claims.claim: The Facilitator setup page ties IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled to AI-generated meeting notes.
claims.quote:
Turn off AI-generated notes for meetings
Loop experiences in Teams control AI-generated notes for meetings, which are enabled by default.
You can manage this control using the IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled setting in PowerShell.

claims.where: Governance controls: Teams New Calendar exception
claims.claim: The SharePoint collaborative-notes property does not apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.where: Governance controls: Facilitator app instructions
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > search and select Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block controls the app.
claims.quote:
select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.
In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.where: Governance controls: Facilitator app default
claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.where: Governance controls: organisation app blocking
claims.claim: Blocking all apps for the organisation also blocks Facilitator.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.where: Governance controls: group app permission policy
claims.claim: Learn describes allowing Facilitator for groups of users through an app permission policy.
claims.quote:
Follow the instructions at Use app permission policies to control user access to apps to create a new app policy for Facilitator.
You can then assign the policy to your entire tenant or to a select group of users.

claims.where: Governance controls: Pro Management settings jobs
claims.claim: Pro Management portal device setting changes are applied as jobs.
claims.quote: An entry is made for every setting change initiated by a user or by the Teams Rooms Pro management service.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls: Apply Now
claims.claim: Apply Now queues a settings job and restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Governance controls: Schedule Later
claims.claim: Schedule Later applies settings during the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.where: Governance controls: XML
claims.claim: Learn says new features such as Tap to take notes will not be added as XML settings.
claims.quote: New features, like "Tap to take notes", will not be added as XML settings.

claims.where: Governance controls: recommended settings surface
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the Pro Management portal's individual and bulk configuration options instead of XML.
claims.quote: We recommend using the individual and bulk settings configuration options within the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal instead of the XML configuration.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout, version check
claims.claim: Some Teams Rooms features require a specific app release before becoming available.
claims.quote: Some features become available only after a specific Microsoft Teams Rooms app release.

claims.where: Open questions: Loop generation change
claims.claim: The Facilitator setup page says Loop file generation was discontinued on 31 July 2026.
claims.quote: As part of this change, Loop file generation has been discontinued as of July 31, 2026.

claims.where: Open questions: live notes
claims.claim: The same notice says Facilitator live notes remain unaffected.
claims.quote: Facilitator live notes remain unaffected.

claims.where: Open questions: in-person storage clarification
claims.claim: The Learn pages do not reconcile the Loop-generation discontinuation with their stated storage of in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person notes Loop file generation July 31 2026 storage. Read facilitator-teams and rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms; one discusses document generation and unaffected live notes, the other still specifies a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, Facilitator app check
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to check is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Confirm the Facilitator app is allowed in the Teams admin center'. Controls table: Take notes button, meeting transcription, IsLoopEnabled, IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled; no Facilitator app row.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Confirm the Facilitator app is allowed'. The documented prerequisite and app instructions can remain in Scope and Governance controls; do not add a control row.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions: retention-label scope
claims.claim: Learn does not resolve whether its cloud-attachment retention-label limitation covers the in-person notes case.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms retention labels eDiscovery limitations. Read facilitator-teams, rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; room notes use SharePoint Embedded, while Purview's notes guidance specifies OneDrive accounts.
